assessed_concepts: Original source task: Explain one way in which concurrency can be managed in the database when two programmers update the same line of code at the same time.
Explain how transaction locking can prevent two clerks from overwriting each other’s edits to the same booking record

markscheme.marking_summary: A transaction obtains a suitable exclusive lock before updating the record. A competing writer waits or retries. The first change is committed before the next writer reads and updates the current value. Releasing locks at the appropriate transaction boundary preserves isolation and avoids a lost update.

• Transaction control language (TCL) commands: BEGIN TRANSACTION, COMMIT, ROLLBACK
